inputs.issue: acceptance/contract.py: validate() accepts a must_pass test that the validation's own `python -m unittest discover` options can never run, and a test listed twice in must_pass. Such a contract can never pass. Expected: validate reports every such required test in an error that names its validation (validation[i]) and the test. It must follow what unittest discovery really does with -s, -t (default: the start directory), -p (default test*.py) and -k, accept every test that discovery can run, and not reject a test only because its file might not exist (the validator does not read files). Everything else about validation stays as it is. Do not change the tests.
